gloss: texture (of food); feel on the teeth; mouthfeel

definitions.gloss: texture (of food); feel on the teeth; mouthfeel
definitions.explanation: The physical sensation a food gives when bitten into — how crisp, soft, chewy, or crunchy it feels against the teeth. A standard term in food writing, product descriptions, and restaurant reviews, focusing specifically on the tactile experience of chewing rather than on taste.

examples.japanese: {歯触|はざわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦クッキー→クッキー：10798_kukkii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦サクサクした→サクサクする：26949_sakusakusuru⟧{歯触|はざわ}りだ。
examples.english: These cookies have a crispy texture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧シャキシャキ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{歯触|はざわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧だ。
examples.english: The crisp texture of the fresh vegetables is what makes this salad so appealing.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧ ('tooth') and ⟦{触|さわ}り→触る：00808_sawaru⟧ ('touch; feel'). Refers specifically to the tactile sensation food makes on the teeth when chewed.

USAGE:
- Typically used as a predicate with ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ or ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧, or modified by an onomatopoeia describing the texture.
- Often appears in food reviews, snack product copy, and cooking shows.
- Distinct from ⟦{口当|くちあ}たり→口当たり：21546_kuchiatari⟧, which covers the overall feel of food in the mouth (smoothness, softness on the tongue), not just the bite.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歯触|はざわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to have a pleasant texture
- サクサク⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歯触|はざわ}り: a crispy texture
- シャキシャキ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{歯触|はざわ}り: a crunchy, crisp texture
- ⟦コリコリ→コリコリ：06846_korikori⟧とした{歯触|はざわ}り: a firm, springy texture (as with cartilage or mushrooms)
- {歯触|はざわ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy the texture

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{口当|くちあ}たり→口当たり：21546_kuchiatari⟧: mouthfeel — broader; describes the overall feel of food or drink in the mouth, including smoothness.
- ⟦{食感|しょっかん}→食感：06636_shokkan⟧: texture (of food) — the most general culinary term; covers both bite and mouthfeel.
- ⟦{舌触|したざわ}り→舌触り：07919_shitazawari⟧: feel on the tongue — focuses on smoothness or roughness against the tongue rather than chewing.
